name: power_wakeup_toggle
cmd: f_name="$name"; echo $state > /sys/devices/platform/*/power/wakeup 2>/dev/null; for f in /sys/class/wakeup/*/name; do if grep -q "${f_name:-.}" $f 2>/dev/null; then d=$(dirname $f); echo $state > $d/device/power/wakeup 2>/dev/null || echo $state > $d/power/wakeup 2>/dev/null; echo "toggled $d"; fi; done; echo '--- 当前 ---'; grep -i -- "${f_name:-.}" /sys/power/wakeup_sources 2>/dev/null | head
